## Checklist

- [ ] Branch name follows `feature/`, `fix/`, `docs/` or `test/` plus a short description
- [ ] Commit messages follow the `feat:`, `fix:`, `docs:`, `test:`, `refactor:` or `chore:` convention
- [ ] Formatting and linting pass (`npm run lint` / `uv run ruff check .`)
- [ ] Type checks pass (`npm run typecheck` / `uv run mypy`)
- [ ] Tests added or updated, and they pass
- [ ] Documentation updated where behaviour, configuration or setup changed
- [ ] No secrets, real bank data, `.env` files or generated dependency folders are included
- [ ] This PR targets `main` and is focused on one change
